description.value: Real Thai Restaurant is an authentic Thai eatery in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, operated by a chef with over 15 years of traditional Thai culinary expertise. The menu spans soups, stir-fries, deep-fries, and desserts including Pad Thai and Thai curry, with reviewers praising fresh ingredients, a wide range of spice levels, and a welcoming atmosphere. Both dine-in and takeout are offered, with table reservations available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 86m; rack at 99m.
